title: feat(governance): namespace/authority drift detector (advisory v1) + anti-inference guard + portable engine surface
intent: Build the repeatable adjudication instrument specified by the pre-governance asset-recovery archaeology (detector requirements R1-R7). Advisory-only v1. Adjudicates whether a candidate change drifts from the DECLARED authority topology. Core boundary: the detector MAY CONSUME authority but MAY NOT CREATE it — missing bindings yield INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Pre-merge hardening adds WHY-NOT-HEURISTICS rationale, NAMESPACE_BINDING_GAP.md, and an anti-inference bait-topology guard. Portability parameterizes Luthiers layout behind DetectorConfig and exposes analyze_namespace_authority_drift() so code-analysis-tool can vendor the Git-independent engine without a second adjudication implementation.
behavior_change: Adds advisory governance tool + tests; anti-inference guard + binding-gap note; DetectorConfig portability surface (Luthiers defaults preserved). Not wired into check_all.py; advisory exit 0. No namespace->domain bindings authored. No adjudication verdict/severity/evidence rule changes from the portable refactor.

diff_articulation.what_changed: (1) Detector: git adapter + candidate-change model + Git-independent engine; CLI advisory. (2) Pre-merge hardening: WHY NOT HEURISTICS header; ANTI-INFERENCE GUARD bait topology tests; NAMESPACE_BINDING_GAP.md. (3) Portability: DetectorConfig + DEFAULT_CONFIG; AuthorityTopology.load(registry_path|config); analyze_namespace_authority_drift(change, topology); git adapter/_namespace_of take optional config; optional --registry. (4) Tests cover verdict families, retopo/BOE dogfoods, anti-inference guard, and config-injection equivalence.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No existing tool adjudicates candidate-change namespace/authority drift. Anti-inference guard is not redundant with unbound-namespace tests (those have nothing to infer from). Portability does not change verdicts; it makes the engine vendorable without forking adjudication.

commands_run: Anti-inference guard retained from pre-merge hardening (bait topology + real-registry pins).
Portability: defaults ≡ module aliases; analyze_namespace_authority_drift ≡ analyze; injected registry path ≡ default load.
Real retopo dogfood: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, 0 flagged, exit 0.
